# Wood Refinishing by Sue Wheeler, LLC

> Architectural wood refinishing for St. Louis's historic homes. Hand-stripped, never dipped. EPA Certified Lead Removal. In business since 1989. Sue answers every call personally.

Sue Wheeler is St. Louis's most trusted specialist for refinishing the architectural woodwork of historic homes — doors, staircases, kitchen cabinets, built-ins, and in-place millwork — and for furniture and antique refinishing. She does not do floors, decks, or new construction.

**Phone:** (314) 367-6054
**Address:** 900 S Boyle Ave, St. Louis, MO 63110 — this is a working shop, not a showroom. Customers may drop off and collect pieces here; most architectural work is done on-site at the customer's home, or by removing pieces to the shop and reinstalling them.
**Hours:** 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Saturday. Closed Sunday.
**Website:** https://suewheelerstl.com

---

## What She Does

- **Door refinishing** — front doors, interior doors, French doors, pocket doors (in-shop or on-premise)
- **Staircase refinishing** — treads, risers, spindles/balusters, newel posts, railings
- **Kitchen cabinet refinishing** — painted, stained, or color-change; priced per door
- **Architectural woodwork** — door frames, window frames, baseboards, wainscoting, crown molding, mantels, built-in hutches and bookcases
- **Furniture & antiques** — dining tables, chairs, dressers, heirloom pieces, antiques; same hand-strip method as architectural work
- **Perk Up & Protect** — maintenance coat (wet sand + color + topcoat) for sound finishes that have lost their luster; no full strip required

## What She Does NOT Do

- Hardwood floors or decks
- Commercial work — bars, restaurants, hospitality venues
- Institutional work — schools, churches, government or municipal buildings
- New construction or freshly painted surfaces

---

## Key Differentiators

- **Hand-stripped, never dipped** — chemical dip tanks raise grain, destroy old-growth joinery, and leave wood looking flat. Sue hand-strips every piece.
- **EPA Certified Lead Removal** — required for pre-1978 homes. Every project on older homes is fully compliant with EPA RRP rules.
- **36 years in business** — founded 1989, still owner-operated
- **Historic home specialist** — works within Secretary of the Interior standards for historic rehabilitation
- **Board-up method** — pieces removed to shop, finished in controlled environment, reinstalled. Keeps dust and fumes out of the home.

---

## Service Area

Sue Wheeler serves the City of St. Louis and St. Louis County, Missouri.

**City neighborhoods:** Central West End, Benton Park, Compton Heights, Shaw, Lafayette Square, Tower Grove
**County municipalities:** Clayton, University City, Maplewood, Brentwood, Kirkwood, Webster Groves, Ladue, Frontenac, Town & Country, Chesterfield, Ballwin

Estimates are free anywhere in the city or county. If you're not sure whether your address is covered, call — Sue answers personally and will tell you directly.

**Limits are on the type of work, not the ZIP code.** See "What She Does NOT Do" above: no hardwood floors, no decks, no commercial or hospitality work, no institutional work.

## Service Pages by Location

Three services carry a page for every one of the 16 neighborhoods listed above — 48 pages, with no gaps in the matrix. Rather than list all 48, here is the pattern:

- https://suewheelerstl.com/door-refinishing/{neighborhood}
- https://suewheelerstl.com/staircase-refinishing/{neighborhood}
- https://suewheelerstl.com/kitchen-cabinet-refinishing/{neighborhood}

`{neighborhood}` is one of: `ballwin`, `benton-park`, `central-west-end`, `chesterfield`, `clayton`, `compton-heights`, `frontenac`, `kirkwood`, `ladue`, `lafayette-square`, `maplewood`, `shaw`, `tower-grove`, `town-and-country`, `university-city`, `webster-groves`

Every combination of the three services and the sixteen neighborhoods resolves to a real page — for example https://suewheelerstl.com/kitchen-cabinet-refinishing/webster-groves.
